name: baseline eval and rebuild timing
command: cd /home/davr/.config/dendritic && echo "== eval toplevel drv ==" && time nix eval .#nixosConfigurations.NIXPC.config.system.build.toplevel.drvPath --impure 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "== rebuild dry run ==" && time nixos-rebuild dry-run --flake .#NIXPC 2>&1 | tail -25
